_README: Authored, one short line per template whose generator interprets its text. The separator and the markers in stencils/v3/_text_syntax.json are DERIVED from the flags the Lua script passes to the host's split(), and the worked example is the template's own generator.text; this file carries only what lives in the script BODY rather than in those flags, which a derived list alone would miss. generate-stencil-index.js FAILS when a template has interprettext: true and no entry here, so a new interpreted shape cannot ship without one. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
avabodh.wireframe.accordion: Each line is one section header; the first line marked with * is the open section and every line after it is stacked at the bottom of the shape.
avabodh.wireframe.androidactionbar: The whole text is the action bar's title; the leading icon and the overflow button are template parameters, not text.
avabodh.wireframe.androiddatepicker: Three slash-separated numbers, year/month/day; the weekday and the month name are computed from them, and an out-of-range month or day falls back to a valid one.
avabodh.wireframe.androidtabbar: Each comma-separated item is one tab; \n gives a tab a second line.
avabodh.wireframe.breadcrumbs: Each comma-separated item is one crumb, with the arrow between crumbs drawn for you; the last crumb is styled as the current page.
avabodh.wireframe.button: The whole text is the button's label; the state (normal, in focus, selected), the icon and the menu arrow are template parameters, not text.
avabodh.wireframe.buttonbar: Each comma-separated item is one button in the bar; \n gives a button a second line.
avabodh.wireframe.calendar: Three slash-separated numbers, year/month/day; the month grid, the weekday and the month name are computed from them, and an out-of-range month or day falls back to a valid one.
avabodh.wireframe.checkbox: The whole text is the label beside the box; checked and the state are template parameters, not text.
avabodh.wireframe.checkboxgroup: Each line is one row: [ ] draws an empty box, [x] a checked one and [-] an indeterminate one, and a line with no leading bracket is a plain label with no box.
avabodh.wireframe.datagrid: The first line is the header row and each comma starts a column; [v] or [^] at the END of a header cell draws a sort chevron, [ ] [x] [-] [o] [()] at the START of a cell draw check and radio marks, and a line of the form {0C, 45L, 0R} anywhere in the text sets each column's width and alignment (L, C or R; 0 means share the remaining width).
avabodh.wireframe.iosactionsheet: Each line is one button and the LAST line is drawn as the separated Cancel button; a single line is drawn as one button with no sheet.
avabodh.wireframe.ioscontextmenu: Each comma-separated item is one entry in the floating bar, with a divider drawn between entries.
avabodh.wireframe.iosmenu: Each line is one row, with a divider between rows; at the start [o] [x] [+] [-] give a bullet, a check, a plus and a minus, and at the end [>] [=] [on] [off] give a chevron, a hamburger and a toggle — any other bracket text is used verbatim as a template name and will not resolve, so keep to these.
avabodh.wireframe.iospicker: Each line is one row and each comma one wheel column; at most seven lines are kept, and the middle line is the row under the selection bar.
avabodh.wireframe.iossegmented: Each comma-separated item is one segment of the control.
avabodh.wireframe.linkbar: Each comma-separated item is one link in the bar.
avabodh.wireframe.listbox: Each line is one item; a leading [name] embeds that template as an icon and the name is used verbatim, so give a full id such as [avabodh.wireframe.icon_check]. The border and the minimum item height are template parameters.
avabodh.wireframe.menu: Each line is one row; a line of only -, --, ---, ---- or = draws a separator row; the text after the last comma is right-aligned, which is where an accelerator goes and where > reads as a submenu; [o] and [x] at the start draw a bullet and a check, and any other bracket text is used verbatim as a template name.
avabodh.wireframe.menubar: Each comma-separated item is one top-level menu title.
avabodh.wireframe.multilinebutton: Every line is a line of the button's label; there are no per-line markers.
avabodh.wireframe.pointybutton: The whole text is the button's label; which side the point is on is a template parameter.
avabodh.wireframe.radiobutton: The whole text is the label beside the dot; checked and the state are template parameters, not text.
avabodh.wireframe.radiobuttongroup: Each line is one row: [( )] or [] draws an empty dot, [o] a selected one and [-] a disabled mark, and a line with no leading bracket is a plain label with no button.
avabodh.wireframe.tabs: Each comma-separated item is one tab, drawn above or below the panel; which edge the tabs sit on and how they are aligned are template parameters.
avabodh.wireframe.tabshead: Each comma-separated item is one tab in the strip — this shape is the tab row on its own, with no panel below it; \n gives a tab a second line.
avabodh.wireframe.tooltip: The whole text is the tooltip's body; which edge the pointer comes out of is a template parameter.
avabodh.wireframe.tree: Each line is one node and leading spaces set its depth; [+] [-] [>] [v] draw expand and collapse controls and [folder] [folder-open] [file] the usual icons — any other bracket text is used verbatim as a template name and will not resolve.
avabodh.wireframe.vtabs: Each line is one tab down the side of the shape.
